name: What is the average cost to have a professional install a lever faucet in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost to have a professional install a lever faucet in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of professional lever faucet installation in the Bay Area can vary significantly based on labor rates, the complexity of the installation, and whether any old parts need removal or disposal. Generally, homeowners can expect to pay between $150 and $400 for labor alone. This estimate does not include the cost of the faucet itself or any additional plumbing repairs that might be discovered during the process. We provide detailed quotes after an assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional lever faucet installation in the Bay Area typically costs $150-$400 for labor, not including the faucet or potential repairs.
